preferences.language_style: Clean, modular, production-ready code with complete type/schema safety
preferences.frontend: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 (dark-mode-first premium tech aesthetics)
preferences.backend: Node.js + Express + MongoDB/Mongoose with RESTful architecture
preferences.state_management: Context API / Redux Toolkit for complex shared state
code_rules: Always write modular, self-contained components and controllers
Ensure proper error handling with descriptive JSON responses
Avoid placeholders or stub functions — deliver working implementations
Never destroy existing working functionality when refactoring
Keep UI responsive, accessible, and visually stunning with micro-animations

ai_interaction.response_style: Concise, technical, precise, zero-fluff, highly actionable
ai_interaction.mandatory_cross_model_rule: Always consult brain_summary.md on every new prompt. Update memory upon key decisions.
